title: Renew your Semester Pass
body: Renew now and the next 120 days start the moment this one ends, so you lose no days. One payment, nothing renews by itself.
confirmEmailFirst: A plan is already billed to this email, so renewing needs a confirmed email first. Log out, choose “Email me a sign-in link” on the sign-in page, and open the link we send you. Then renew here.
confirmEmailEffects: Confirming signs you out on your other devices and in connected apps such as Claude, and your password stops working. Choose “Forgot your password?” on the sign-in page to set a new one.
